post.description:
Returns details for selected document revision IDs in a project.

Pass `view=ids_only` to receive an array of Document Revision ids instead of full objects.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Optional response view. Omit or pass `default` for full Document Revision objects. `ids_only` returns an array of ids and raises the `per_page` ceiling from 100 to 5000. The published `per_page` maximum reflects the default view.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Comma-separated set of attributes to sort the list of records by.
    
Format: :primary_sort_attribute,:secondary_sort_attribute
    
Valid sort attribute options are [<field_id>, file_format, file_size, created_at, uploaded_at]

ids.description: Array of Document Revision IDs to fetch.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next and last link

message.example: Sorry, we couldn't publish the file at this time. Please try again later.

workflow.description: Workflow integration information for this document revision. See `status` for blocking semantics.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the workflow integration. `created`, `creation_requested`, and `termination_requested` block recycle and other writes that would orphan an in-flight external workflow instance.

workflow_instance_id.description: ID of the most recent workflow instance. Retained after the workflow ends or is terminated.

latest_workflow_integration_event_timest.description: Timestamp of the most recent workflow lifecycle event (started/updated/ended).

latest_workflow_operation_event_timestam.description: Timestamp of the most recent workflow operation metadata event (e.g. operation_ended).

operation_id.description: ID of the operation that created the workflow, if applicable.

operation_type.description: Type of the operation that created the workflow.

termination_reason.description: Human-readable reason captured when a workflow was terminated.

terminated_at.description: Timestamp when the workflow was terminated, if applicable.

terminated_status_id.description: ID of the status the document revision was set to on workflow termination.

selected_preset_id.description: ID of the workflow preset selected for this workflow instance.

download_url.description: Download URL for the revision. Omitted when the row is masked — either the caller lacks view permission, or the revision was recycled after the list was assembled.

recycled.description: Whether the revision is in the Recycle Bin.

latest_event_id.description: Event ID for optimistic concurrency control

index_updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent search-index update for this revision. Falls back to the revision's updated_at when no search-index record is available.

match_type.description: Placeholder-match classification for a placeholder-backed revision row, paired with standalone_upload_id. null when the pairing was cleared; absent when the revision has no placeholder match or the caller lacks view access.

allOf.description: Placeholder-match classification for a placeholder-backed revision row. EXACT or CLOSE when paired with an upload via detection; null when cleared (EXACT confirm/reject/file-delete or CLOSE reject/sibling-cleared/confirm); absent otherwise. standalone_upload_id is paired with both EXACT and CLOSE.

standalone_upload_id.description: For a placeholder revision row with an active match, the id of the paired standalone upload. null when the pairing was cleared; absent when the revision has no placeholder match or the caller lacks view access.

upload_id.description: Originating document-upload id for this revision.

workflow_terminations_for_container.description: Workflow termination context persisted on the revision when a submit resolved container conflicts. Absent when the revision has no pending terminations.

termination_reason.example: Document superseded by a new revision

workflow_creation_initiating_user_id.description: User id that initiated workflow creation for this revision. Present when an assigned workflow was requested at submit.

workflow_assignee_roles.description: Structured per-assignee workflow role state. Source of truth for the workflow_current_step_roles field; emitted when tuples have been written on the revision.

data.description: Document Revision ids. Returned when `view=ids_only` is passed.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"ids\":[\"string\"]}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.2/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/document_management/document_revisions/selected_revisions?view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&locale=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
